intent: Phase 0, leg 1: fix e2e-smoke and docker-image, red on dev since the S1 auth hotfix, without weakening either. Warrant WG-DEL-004 and the constitution's rule that no session weakens, skips or deletes a failing check; a gate that is red and unwatched is not a gate. Source row WO-0018, plan org/plans/2026-08-consolidation.md Phase 0. Diagnosis carried in: src/proxy.ts:112 fails closed with 503 when no token file exists, and the Playwright harness ran against a wiped CH_DATA_DIR and never minted a token, so all three smoke failures were credential starvation rather than app defects; docker-image was diagnosed from run 30226692050 as the smoke harness probing PS_DOCKER_TEST_PORT=42090 while the container boots healthy on 42069. Operator ruling D3, 2026-08-22: fix docker-image, harness and env plumbing first, touch the image only if evidence demands; removal is moot because branch protection has zero required checks. The row forbids fixing e2e-smoke by setting PS_AUTH_MODE=none, which would permanently un-test the most security-critical code in a repository that already shipped an unauthenticated RCE once. Acceptance: (1) e2e-smoke green with auth genuinely exercised; (2) one test proving an unauthenticated request is refused; (3) docker-image diagnosed and either fixed or removed with a reason; (4) the local gate documented as not a substitute for CI; (5) added by plan amendment 2026-08-22, the baseline photograph captured verbatim at close, meaning the full knip report (38 unused exports, 18 unused types, 2 unresolved, 1 duplicate, 11 unlisted-binary occurrences), the design-lint totals (918 overall, sql-outside-repository 57 sites in 19 files, hermes-outside-adapter 21 crossings in 13 files), the jest count, coverage and a clean build. Done when CI on dev is green and its status is checked before any session claims a gate passed. Closed by commit 47b59b01, 2026-08-22: playwright.config.ts mints a per-run token and carries it as a Bearer header, one new test pins the boundary, an unauthenticated /api/stats gets 401 while /api/health stays public, and the docker readiness probe moved to /api/health because curl -f read the new 401 as a dead port, so the port was never the defect. No app code changed, no assertion was weakened, no retry was added, PS_AUTH_MODE was untouched, and an independent agent that wrote none of it approved. Acceptance item 5 is NOT satisfied by that commit: no baseline photograph exists anywhere in the tree, and T-0007 names it as its input, so it is carried onto T-0007 as a precondition rather than lost. Tier proposal R2, anticipated factor ci-stateful-infra from derived signal ci-config; the gate recomputation over 47b59b01 confirms it.
